summary: Li Auto Inc. filed a Form 6-K with a press release reporting its April 2026 delivery update. The company delivered 34,085 vehicles in April, with cumulative deliveries reaching 1,669,442 as of April 30, 2026. The filing also announced the debut of the all-new Li L9 Livis at a Beijing auto show, with an official launch scheduled for May 15. No special-situation corporate event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or forced management change is involved. The filing is a routine operational update with no deal terms.
